speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: The core feature of PFP is to inject flexibility into the posting system, recognising the fact that students blossom at different times and have different strengths.

speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Education)
text: Teachers and ECG counsellors guide students to explore different education pathways, different industries and job roles.
